About

MACHINES & CLOUD · HOUSTON, TEXAS

Good service starts
before you get there.

You can’t stop a job for every call. Your customers still need an answer. We build AI front desks for home service shops, so both get taken care of.

See the front desk in action
↗

THE PERSON BEHIND YOUR FRONT DESK

Hands-on setup.
Direct support.

Machines & Cloud is run by Steve Ngoumnai, a Houston engineer with ten years running production systems.

Your services, hours, fees and handoff rules are checked with you. You test the front desk on a private line before it takes a customer call, and you have someone to contact when things need changing.

Start a free pilot
↗
LinkedIn
↗

WHAT WE BUILD AROUND

Your business stays yours.
Your number

Keep the number your customers already know. Decide which calls the front desk handles and which go straight to you.

Your rules

Your published fees and arrival windows. Your emergency instructions. A real person for the questions that need one.

Your customers

Read the conversations and export your records. One shop’s conversations are never used to run another shop’s front desk.

BUILT IN HOUSTON

Let’s talk about your shop.
5718 Westheimer Rd, Suite 1000
Houston, TX 77057

(346) 248-8359
support@machinesandcloud.com

WHO WE WORK WITH

For people
who work with their hands.

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and cleaning businesses. Houston first, with remote setup available for service shops elsewhere in the US.

Find the plan for your shop
↗

to a busy day.
